materials.name: PLA / PLA+
materials.subtitle: Polylactic Acid (Biopolymer)
materials.tagline: Best for visual prototypes, display models, and cost-effective general parts.
advantages: Crisp surface finish with near-invisible layer lines at fine settings
High dimensional accuracy and low shrinkage
Most cost-effective material for rapid iterations
limitations: Deforms in hot car interiors or prolonged direct sunlight above 55°C
Brittle under sudden high impact loads

materials.name: PETG
materials.subtitle: Polyethylene Terephthalate Glycol
materials.tagline: The ultimate everyday engineering material: tough, heat-resistant, and weather-proof.
advantages: Exceptional layer adhesion and impact resistance
Resists outdoor UV exposure, moisture, and mild chemicals
limitations: Slightly more stringing on tiny overhangs than PLA
Glossier surface unless printed in matte variant

materials.name: TPU 95A
materials.subtitle: Thermoplastic Polyurethane (Elastomer)
materials.tagline: Rubber-like flexibility, extreme impact absorption, and tear resistance.
advantages: Bendable, shock-absorbing, and virtually unbreakable under drops
Excellent abrasion and chemical resistance against grease and oils
Great grip and vibration dampening properties
limitations: Cannot bridge large gaps without support

materials.name: ABS / ASA
materials.subtitle: Acrylonitrile Styrene Acrylate / ABS
materials.tagline: Industrial-grade thermal resistance and extreme UV stability for automotive & outdoor use.
advantages: Withstands extreme heat up to 95-100°C without warping
ASA is 100% UV resistant (does not yellow in continuous sun)
Can be post-processed, sanded, and acetone vapor smoothed
limitations: Requires heated chamber and specialized ventilation
Higher shrinkage factor requires calibrated CAD scaling

materials.name: Carbon-Fiber PETG
materials.subtitle: Carbon Fiber Reinforced Composite
materials.tagline: Maximum rigidity, lightweight performance, and a stunning matte textured finish.
advantages: Infused with chopped micro-carbon fibers for extreme stiffness
Zero visible layer lines thanks to matte micro-texture
High strength-to-weight ratio and dimensional stability
limitations: Reduced impact flexibility compared to pure PETG

portfolio.title: Automotive Hood Insulation Clip
portfolio.shortDescription: A discontinued automotive clip recreated to replace an unavailable OEM component.
portfolio.challenge: The vehicle manufacturer discontinued the specialized plastic retention clips for the engine hood soundproofing blanket. Purchasing aftermarket clips resulted in loose fitment and rattling.
portfolio.solution: We measured the surviving broken clip with digital calipers, modeled the exact snap-fit locking tabs in CAD with reinforced fillet geometry, and printed a batch of 12 in heat-resistant PETG.
portfolio.result: Perfect snug fitment, resisting engine bay temperatures with zero deformation after thousands of kilometers.

portfolio.title: Custom Equipment Mounting Bracket
portfolio.shortDescription: A functional mounting bracket designed around bespoke customer dimensions for an industrial sensor rig.
portfolio.challenge: A local automation client needed to mount optical barcode scanners onto 4040 aluminum profiles at a precise 32-degree tilt angle that standard off-the-shelf brackets could not accommodate.
portfolio.solution: Engineered a custom dual-clamp bracket with integrated M5 hex nut pockets and internal cable routing channels, printed with 50% gyroid infill for maximum torsional stiffness.
portfolio.result: Eliminated custom CNC machining lead time from 3 weeks to just 24 hours, at 80% lower cost.

portfolio.title: Flexible Protective Impact Insert
portfolio.shortDescription: A flexible part manufactured for impact protection and vibration isolation on precision measuring tools.
portfolio.challenge: Sensitive laser measuring instruments were incurring edge damage during field deployments in rugged construction environments.
portfolio.solution: Created an ergonomic snug-fit protective bumper sleeve in flexible 95A TPU featuring corner air-cushion cavities for drop shock absorption.
portfolio.result: Full drop protection without adding bulky weight or impeding access to optical sensors.

portfolio.title: Smart Home Hub Prototype Enclosure
portfolio.shortDescription: A rapid prototype created for dimensional PCB fitment and industrial design validation.
portfolio.challenge: A hardware startup needed to validate physical ergonomics, internal PCB clearance, and snap-fit battery doors before committing to 15,000 EUR injection molding tooling.
portfolio.solution: Printed the two-piece enclosure in ultra-fine 0.12mm layer height with smooth matte surface finish and precise internal PCB standoffs.
portfolio.result: Identified a 1.2mm USB-C port alignment discrepancy early, saving thousands in potential mold re-tooling costs.

portfolio.title: Heavy-Lift Drone Landing Gear Dampener
portfolio.shortDescription: Dual-density landing assembly combining rigid carbon-fiber struts with shock-absorbing elastomer feet.
portfolio.challenge: Heavy camera gimbals on surveying drones were transmitting landing vibrations into sensitive sensor payloads.
portfolio.solution: Designed a hybrid landing foot with a stiff carbon-composite top collar and a hollow honeycomb TPU base foot.
portfolio.result: Over 65% reduction in landing shock telemetry and 0 cracked drone legs during field testing.

portfolio.title: Cinema Camera Rig Quick-Release Adapter

faqs.question: What 3D file formats do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept all standard 3D formats including STL, STEP (.step / .stp), 3MF, and OBJ. For CAD design or reverse-engineering projects, you can also upload dimensioned 2D drawings (PDF), sketches, or high-resolution photos with caliper measurements.

faqs.question: What if I don't have a 3D model?
faqs.answer: No problem! Layer Studios offers full CAD & 3D Design services. You can describe your idea, send us a broken part to reverse-engineer, or share simple sketches with measurements. We will create the 3D model, send you renders for approval, and print the finished part.

faqs.question: How long does 3D printing and delivery take?
faqs.answer: Standard production typically takes 2 to 4 business days depending on model complexity and batch volume. We also offer an Express Rush option (24–48h). Shipping within continental Portugal takes 24h via CTT Expresso, and 2–5 days across Europe.

faqs.question: How accurate and strong are 3D printed parts?
faqs.answer: Our calibrated precision printers achieve dimensional tolerances within approximately ±0.15mm for standard features. Part strength depends on material choice and infill orientation — with PETG, ASA, or Carbon-Fiber PETG at 50–100% infill, parts easily replace injection-molded or machined plastic components for demanding mechanical uses.

faqs.question: Which material should I choose?
faqs.answer: For prototypes and decorative pieces: PLA+ is ideal. For functional mechanical, outdoor, or automotive interior parts: PETG is our recommended workhorse. For flexible, impact-absorbing parts: TPU 95A is unbeatable. For extreme heat (>90°C) or UV sun exposure: ABS/ASA. You can also use our interactive Material Advisor on the Materials page or ask our team.

faqs.question: Are 3D printed parts food safe or watertight?
faqs.answer: While the raw resins like PETG or PLA are non-toxic, standard FDM 3D printing creates microscopic layer lines where bacteria can harbor, and brass nozzles may contain trace lead. Layer Studios advises against using standard FDM prints for long-term food-contact or sterile medical applications without specialized food-safe epoxy post-coating. For watertight containers, we optimize wall counts and slicer flow rates upon request.

faqs.question: Can I order multiple copies or small batches?
faqs.answer: Yes! We specialize in small-batch manufacturing from 10 to 100+ units. We offer automated tiered volume discounts (10% off for 10+ units, 18% off for 25+, 25% off for 50+, and up to 35% off for 100+ units) with consistent quality control across every part.

faqs.question: Can you print copyrighted or branded models?
faqs.answer: We respect intellectual property rights. We cannot manufacture models that infringe upon registered trademarks, patented mechanisms, or copyrighted character merchandise without verifiable authorization from the rights holder.

faqs.question: Do you ship internationally and what payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We ship across all of Portugal (continental & autonomous islands), throughout the European Union, and worldwide. We accept MB WAY, Multibanco reference, Credit/Debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex), and Bank Transfer.
